measured_subtotals_not_wall_partition.warning: Observed operation durations; not person-hours or end-to-end wall time. Author wall includes coordination/schema/reviews. Parallel tasks may overlap. Unknown queue durations remain null.

methodology: UTC report/application timestamps provide chronological anchors; no start timestamp is inferred by subtraction.
Author stage has explicit start/end; schema command events use tracker logging timestamps, not invented command starts.
Untimestamped release/audit/census durations kept separately with their explicit partial order.
Cargo compile fields measure build commands including checking/cache/link overhead; not compiler CPU time.
Release metadata and process metadata describe the same build; counted once; separate link counted once.
Failed build/zero-test/obsolete DATA expectations retained. No aggregate number treats them as successful proofs.
All root timing/outcome reports inventoried; backups, raw Rust snapshots and executables are evidence inputs, not new measurements.
test_proof_limits: No Cargo or new audit executed to produce this report. It summarizes recorded evidence only.
